info.name: Document sorter
Sortare documente
info.summary: Reads your scanned documents, tells what they are (identity card, certificate, invoice, contract) and files them by kind
Citește documentele scanate, spune ce sunt (buletin, certificat, factură, contract) și le așază în dosare după fel
info.description: Drop scans, photos and PDFs into an inbox folder. The app reads the text of each one (pdftotext for PDFs with text, RapidOCR — neural text recognition — for pictures and scans), recognises the kind of document from what is written on it (identity documents, civil status certificates, permits and licences, vehicle papers, invoices and receipts, bank and tax papers, contracts, property, health, education, work, utilities, insurance …), tags it and moves it into Documents/<category>/<kind>/. The rules are plain keyword lists, in Romanian and English, that the administrator can extend. The text of a document is never stored: only its kind.
info.author: Cristian Casapu
